nodes.label: LineChart
nodes.desc: Thin forwardRef wrapper that hands CartesianChart a chartName, a default tooltip event type and an array tooltip payload searcher.

nodes.label: CartesianChart
nodes.desc: Central factory component: resolves default props, wraps children in a fresh Redux store and reports root chart props into it.

nodes.label: CategoricalChart
nodes.desc: Renders the actual SVG tree: a RechartsWrapper div, a RootSurface and a ClipPathProvider; compact mode serves the Brush panorama.

nodes.label: RechartsWrapper
nodes.desc: Outer div that attaches mouse/touch handlers and observes its own size with ResizeObserver to feed ReportChartSize.

nodes.label: ResponsiveContainer
nodes.desc: Observes the parent element with ResizeObserver and funnels width/height down into the chart, with optional throttled debounce.

nodes.label: Surface
nodes.desc: The single <svg> element every chart renders into, with viewBox, title and desc for accessibility.

nodes.label: RechartsStoreProvider
nodes.desc: Creates one independent store per chart via useRef; Brush panoramas skip the Provider and inherit the root chart's store.

nodes.label: createRechartsStore
nodes.desc: configureStore with 18 combined reducers, five event middlewares and an autoBatchEnhancer that queues notifications on requestAnimationFrame.

nodes.label: useAppSelector
nodes.desc: Recharts-variant of useSelector built on useSyncExternalStoreWithSelector; returns undefined instead of throwing outside a chart.

nodes.label: CartesianAxis
nodes.desc: Renders axis line, ticks and labels from a scale selected out of the store; reports its rendered ticks back into renderedTicksSlice.

nodes.label: Line
nodes.desc: Registers its settings into the store and derives its point list via the selectLinePoints reselect selector.

nodes.label: Tooltip
nodes.desc: Reads tooltip interaction state and payload entries from the store and positions the TooltipBoundingBox over the active coordinate.
